[[Lieutenant Murunda]] is an officer of the Vabbian military and the trusted aide of [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]].  She gives players numerous quests and is the mission access [[Non-player character|NPC]] for the [[Dzagonur Bastion]] mission.

==Dialogue==
Zehlon Reach:
:''"I hope [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty|Prince Ahmtur]] will be able to handle everything while I'm down here in [[Istan]]."''

Tihark Orchard:
:''"You don't exactly look like the usual guest. Got the smell of battle and blood about ya. Don't look so surprised; when you've been around the smell as often as I have you come to recognize it. I report to Prince Ahmtur the Mighty. He's master over the regions near the [[Citadel of Dzagon|Dzagon Citadel]] and the outlands."''
:'''Tell me about Prince Ahmtur the Mighty.'''
::''The prince is the most honorable man I've had the pleasure of serving. Were it up to me, I'd throw the other two down the well, and put Prince Ahmtur in charge of all of [[Vabbi]]. Of the three great principalities, my lord was granted the worst piece of the territory. His section of the province is mostly unpopulated; his bastion of power is in his citadel on the edge of the wilderness. We spend most of our lives fighting of the inhuman tribes so that the rest of Vabbi is safe to ignore the world and focus on itself."''
:'''Tell me about the lands near the Citadel.'''
::''"The land near my home are a broken region of mountains, caves, and badlands where creatures from beyond reside. It is home to [[harpy|skree harpies]], [[heket]], and other deadly and vile creatures. Long ago the eastern borders were guarded by massive forces. Alas, between the [[Princes of Vabbi|three princes]], only Prince Ahmtur provides forces to protect the border. The others believe no threat exists, though it would take only a day for them to see the truth."''
:;Thank you for your time. Good day.

Dzagonur Bastion outpost:
:''"Ahai. We protect Vabbi from the heket. It's good pay and honest work. We serve Prince Ahmtur, whose wealth funds the Citadel's defenses...a noble gesture that the other princes take for granted."''
:{{ask|gold}} '''We are here to defend the Citadel!''' (After completing [[Calling the Order]] or [[Greed and Regret]].)
::''"Our scouts have reported enemy forces on the move. The assault on Dzagon Citadel is imminent. Are you ready fight with us?"''
::{{yes}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the mission if [[Master of Whispers]] is in the [[party]].)
:::''"Where's the Master of Whispers? After calling the Order of the Whispers to our aid, he should be here to lead them into battle. Besides, I want him watching over my darling [[Norgu]]. I'm worried he'll get hurt."'' (If Master of Whispers is not in the party.)
::;{{no|ingame}} We are not ready yet.

Dzagonur Bastion mission:
:''"Good to see you again, <character name>. Though I wish it had been under different circumstances. The prince has provided us with some troops. Just tell the [[Disciple of Secrets|Disciples of Secrets]] where you would like them to position their squadrons.''

:''"Fight with honor, <character name>, and do not let the [[Kourna]]ns break past our defenses."''

The Mirror of Lyss (during The Search for Survivors and Reclaiming the Temple):
:''"You don't exactly look like the usual guest. Got the smell of battle and blood about ya. Don't look so surprised; when you've been around the smell as often as I have you come to recognize it. I report to Prince Ahmtur the Mighty. He's master over the regions near the [[Citadel of Dzagon|Dzagon Citadel]] and the outlands."''
